'''The Wingshielder''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Horai Wingshielder]], a [[boss]] in [[Dalada Uplands]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Healing Prayers spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Winged Staff]], with the difference of green instead of red cloth.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Healing Prayers]] [[staves]]:
**[[Holy Branch]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription
